Slash command.d: An instruction to Claude Code itself, typed at the start of a message inside a session, such as /model or /clear.

Subcommand.d: A second word after a program's name that picks one of its jobs, as in 'claude mcp list' or 'claude doctor'. Run from your normal terminal.

CLI flag.d: An option added to a command when you start it, beginning with - or --, such as --model opus. It takes effect once, at start-up.

Shell mode.d: In Claude Code, starting a message with ! runs that shell command yourself straight away; the output joins the conversation and Claude responds to it.

Keybindings file.d: ~/.claude/keybindings.json, where you can change Claude Code's keyboard shortcuts. Open it with /keybindings.
